title: Official CLI emits untyped infrastructure errors
observation: read_source uses fs::read_to_string then raw eprintln!(Error reading file...) and exit(1), without constructing Diagnostic. The check/build/run entry paths call it directly. The error is infrastructure I/O, so DIAG-2 source-span rule is not being applied to it; DIAG-1 still covers every user-visible compiler error.
reachability: CONFIRMED official CLI debug/release check/build: 4 missing-source replays exit1, raw I/O error with no typed diagnostic header.
notes: manifest directly formats MlibError; build-sysroot returns raw Result<(), String> including parse/dependency/lock errors (sysroot_builder.rs:20,53,73,112,121,182). Ordinary compiler failures eventually use typed diagnostics; string transport itself is not automatically a violation.
replay_limits: Execution establishes selected ordinary paths are reached; structural label storage/phase ownership remains traced in pinned source, not inferred from arrow counts.

title: Move and loan failures omit structural antecedent origins
observation: MoveAnalyzer check_place stores only current optional span; it tracks MoveState, not a source move label. BorrowAnalyzer check_access/issue_loan has loan.id available but only assigns current span. Neither module calls with_related or mutates related. Borrowck and driver append these diagnostics unchanged; renderer can only render labels already present.

title: Rendered wording determines diagnostic deduplication and test identity
observation: The analyzers select duplicate diagnostics using d.message == msg or d.message == diag.message plus span. macro duplicate test asserts message.contains rather than typed code/span. region_cutover_tests accepts matching code OR wording and locates order with that same fallback.
reachability: Direct analysis implementation and existing automated test definitions; no execution needed to observe their identity predicate.
notes: Not every presentation assertion violates DIAG-4. Here wording selects identity/dedup or substitutes for typed identity, not merely renderer appearance.

title: Source-category constructors permit absent or fabricated primary spans
observation: MissingReturnValue is constructed with no span at all; LifetimeError UnsatisfiableConstraint/AnalysisTimeout conversions omit span; Mono barrier falls back to FileId(0),0..0; default-outlives can return unspanned E2016. Diagnostic public fields permit code/span None and source_error is not universal admission.
reachability: Constructor/call-graph evidence only. No current generator construction of Terminator::MissingReturn was found, so do not claim an executed CLI missing-return failure. Optional adapters need producer-path admission proof; synthetic fallback is not proof of correct source event.
notes: DIAG-2 universal release proof cannot be granted. Actual reachable span absence remains separately UNVERIFIED until replay or stronger producer proof.

title: Unordered collection iteration can select diagnostic order and primary cause
observation: active_loans returns HashSet and check_access/issue_loan iterate it. Boundary diagnostic loan_span is loans.iter().next() over a HashSet, and carrier maps iterate HashMap. No sorting was found before these emissions. Multiple distinct active origins need repeated-process controls.
reachability: Static risk demonstrated; no nondeterministic output pair executed here. Not labeled BROKEN solely from collection type.
